meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: Claude 会把当前对话内容和代码库状况综合成一份产品规格(PRD),按固定模板写好后发布到项目的问题跟踪器,并自动打上 ready-for-agent 标签。它不会追着你问需求,只基于你们已经聊过的内容来写。
howto.when: 当你要求把当前对话整理成产品规格(PRD)并发布到项目 issue 跟踪器时触发。它不会追问需求,只基于已有讨论和代码库情况来写。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的缓存清理方案写成 spec 并发到 issue
say.note: 它不会追问,直接综合对话内容写并发布

say.text: 把我们已经聊完的功能做成规格,发布到项目跟踪器
say.note: 会按模板生成完整 PRD

howto.what_en: Turns the conversation and codebase understanding into a PRD, publishes it to the project issue tracker with the ready-for-agent label. No interview—just synthesize what was discussed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn the current conversation into a spec (PRD) and publish it to the project issue tracker. It doesn't interview you—it synthesizes the existing discussion and codebase context.

say_en.text: Turn our cache-cleanup discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
say_en.note: It won't ask; it synthesizes the conversation and publishes.

say_en.text: Use to-spec to turn the chat into a PRD and label it ready-for-agent.
say_en.note: Published with the triage label automatically.

say_en.text: Turn our finished feature discussion into a spec and publish to the tracker.
say_en.note: Generates the full PRD from the template.
